voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Alexandria, Egypt. Around two hundred eighty B.C., Alexander the Great was laid to rest here, in a coffin of gold.
That tomb has been lost for more than fifteen hundred years.
Julius Caesar came to see him. Augustus laid a golden crown on the body.
Around the year four hundred, a preacher asked, where is the tomb of Alexander? Even his own people, he said, did not know.
Over a hundred and forty official searches have failed. Theories point beneath the city, to the desert, even to Venice.
